name: Quebec: who may attend English public school
name_fr: Québec : admissibilité à l'enseignement en anglais
description: Preschool, elementary and secondary instruction in Quebec is in French by default. English public (and subsidised private) school is open to children who meet Charter criteria — essentially a Canadian-citizen parent with English schooling in Canada — or who receive a temporary authorization while their family is in Quebec temporarily.

attributes.jurisdiction: Quebec (Charter of the French language, ss. 72–88)
attributes.legal_status: in force; Bill 96 (assented 2022-06-01) amended the temporary-stay rules
attributes.permanent_residents_and_immigrants: Children who settle permanently follow the French-school rule; eligibility for English requires a parent who is a Canadian citizen plus a qualifying situation such as English schooling in Canada. PR status alone does not confer eligibility.
attributes.temporary_stays: Temporary authorization possible for children in Quebec temporarily to study, or dependants of people in Quebec temporarily to study or work (foreign nationals holding a certificate, permit or exemption; Canadian citizens or PRs from another province; foreign officials; Canadian Armed Forces).
attributes.temporary_authorization_duration: The Charter (s. 85) leaves the period to regulation and the official page says 'special rules govern the maximum duration'; secondary sources (McGill Family Care Office; reporting on Bill 96) describe a maximum of 3 years, issued once and not renewable, and not beyond the validity of the immigration document. Not confirmed from the regulation text.
attributes.particular_circumstances: Serious learning disabilities or serious family or humanitarian reasons
attributes.application: Through the chosen school, which submits to the Ministry; decisions usually within 15 working days (current year); contestable before the Administrative Tribunal of Québec within 60 days.
attributes.not_covered_here: Unsubsidised private schools, CEGEP admission rules (Bill 96 caps on English CEGEPs), homeschooling — Agent 03's lane
attributes.practical_effect: If the family settles in Quebec as permanent residents, children will normally attend French school. A temporary stay can buy a limited period of English schooling.
attributes.status_dependency: Matters only if Quebec is in scope (USER-PROFILE.md: 'English-only vs bilingual environment' unknown) and depends on the user's status and French ability (unknown).
